correctness.rationale: The orbit relation was reconstructed as a countable Borel relation; the recent hyperfiniteness theorem was matched to the exact hypotheses; Dougherty--Jackson--Kechris supplies both a same-space Borel Z-action realization and the upper reduction to eventual equality; and Harrington--Kechris--Louveau supplies the lower reduction in the nonsmooth case.

originality.rationale: The recent ownership and independent follow-up papers state hyperfiniteness or asymptotic-dimension results but not the combined single-automorphism compression and exact smooth-versus-eventual-equality classification. Targeted searches using automorphism, Z-action, bireducibility, smoothness, and bounded-to-one commutative-monoid terminology found no equivalent or stronger explicit statement.

value.rationale: The result shows both that the whole orbit partition of countably many possibly noninvertible commuting maps can be generated by one Borel automorphism and that every nonsmooth instance has exactly the E0 Borel degree.
